name: Claude Connectors Setup Guide
description_md:
Set up the five Claude connections from the video in one guided session.

You get a setup guide for Perplexity, Firecrawl, PostHog, Playwright and Composio, plus a copyable prompt that asks Claude Code to inspect your existing setup, guide each sign-in and test each connection.

Each service needs its own account access. Some services charge for usage. The guide is free, with a $0 suggested contribution. It covers Claude Code; setup in Claude's website is different.

Checked against official documentation on November 27, 2026. Instructions and account requirements can change. This is a documented setup guide, with results to verify on your own accounts.
